names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Ιουλίου, «Όσιος Μωησής ο θαυματουργός», with the rank word and the byname left off; the page spells the name this way in both its line and its head. It glosses it as a Hebrew word, the one saved out of the waters.

Name page 1571 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Преподобный Моисей Печерский»; «Преподобный» is a rank word and is stripped, and the epithet is kept. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the folder previously held only the Greek Μωησής and no Russian form at all.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 июля ст. ст. — «Прп. Моисея , чудотворца Печерского (XIII-XIV).»

attestations.note: The day's ninth entry, and the same menologion day as the folder's Greek row, the only other it has. «Прп.» and «чудотворца» are the `venerable` and `wonderworker` the folder's `types` already carry. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN: the line's «(XIII-XIV)» would be this folder's first date of any kind and this wave has declined to write a first date off a line's Roman numerals. The index id1571 was NOT opened, the folder's life being already written. TWO HYMNS TAKEN where the folder had none; BOTH ARE TITLED «в Дальних пещерах почивающаго», resting in the Far Caves, which the folder's own epithet does not say and which was not written into it — it is in the hymns' citations instead. The second hymn describes an iron belt and an iron cross he wore; that is a hymn and not a life and nothing was added to the life from it.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Μωησής ο θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is not `moses-the-hungarian`, the other man of the name whom the Lavra of the Caves holds and whom the menologion keeps on 26 July — that man is a Hungarian servant of Boris sold into slavery, and this one is an ascetic in chains under a heavy cross with the gift of wonders; nor is he `moses-of-novgorod`, `moses-of-the-white-lake`, `moses-of-optina`, `moses-the-ethiopian` or any other of the corpus's men of the name, none of whom is kept on 28 July. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence; the page gives no year at all, so there is no `dates` object, and it prints no hymn and no distich. The Lavra of the Caves is named and `locations` is left out, the page naming no town.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

hymns.text: Велия исправления и крепкия подвиги во псалмопениих же и коленопреклонениих бесчисленных показавши и многими труды и чудодействии, богоносе Моисее, просиявый, моли Христа Бога во еже спастися нам.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 июля ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобнаго Моисея, в Дальних пещерах почивающаго», глас 1

english.text: Showing great amendments and strong struggles in psalmody and in prostrations beyond counting, and shining with many labours and workings of wonders, O God-bearing Moses: pray to Christ God that we may be saved.

hymns.text: Являя твердую и неразоримую свою любовь ко Господу, поясом железным его ради поясался еси, к сему и крест железен присно на себе носил еси велий, преподобне Моисее, в коем стеснении сый, еже и делы ручными удручался еси, за еже велиими чудесы обогащася и Царствию Христову общник явлься, моли и нам в тожде вселитися.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 июля ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобнаго Моисея, в Дальних пещерах почивающаго», глас 1

english.text: Showing thy firm and indestructible love for the Lord, thou didst gird thyself with an iron belt for His sake, and beyond that thou didst always carry a great iron cross upon thee, O venerable Moses; and being in that narrowness, and wearing thyself out besides with the work of thy hands, thou wast therefore enriched with great wonders and shown to be a partaker of the kingdom of Christ. Pray that we too may dwell in it.
